Hana (PM): quick sync: i need a compact stakeholder handoff for the long-term routing/isolation roadmap. goal: single slide + acceptance checklist for pilot invites.
Owen (Eng): ack. include tech risks: KV cache cold-start, batching tail, model-variant parity. we should state required perf targets.
Priya (Infra): for pilot checklist: autoscaler 60s, placement tags, egress delta estimate, scheduler enforcement.
Leo (SRE): ops acceptance: canary playbook (1%/48h, 10%/7d), alert thresholds, incident runbook tabletop complete.
Nadia (Sales): customers ask for migration window + fallback guarantees. sales wants a short blurb about expected downtime and credits.
Counsel (Legal): will draft pilot vs SLA contract snippets. need precise defs for "outage" and "data residency fallback."
Hana (PM): proposed acceptance checklist lines: infra gating, runtime gating, sré gating, docs+contracts. each must be ticked before pilot invites.
Owen (Eng): runtime gating detail: KV hit >=80% steady state, batching tail < 200ms, compatibility matrix exists for model variants.
Priya (Infra): i'll produce egress numbers for top 3 regions and a scheduler proposal in 10 business days.
Leo (SRE): i'll mock the canary dashboard and the automatic rollback policy.
Nadia (Sales): i'll prepare a 1-pager for GTM describing lanes (shared/reserved/private) and onboarding checklist.
Hana (PM): thanks. action: everyone post a 2-3 line owner plan here by Thu EOD. i'll compile slide and checklist and circulate to execs.
SyncBot: reminder: platform-roadmap sync Tue 10am. task created PLAT-5222.
